title: GOAL: parallel machine — per-module tests with a shared harness, task dependencies with daemon-driven gate/review/merge/dispatch, pre-execution spec review
spec: User goal 2026-09-18: the same work should take about a third of the wall clock. Evidence from goal T-0005: 105 min of worker compute over 7.5 h; workers busy a quarter of the time. Causes ranked: (1) every execute task edits tests/test_orchestrator.py (800 lines, 16 classes), forcing strict serialization; (2) each pipeline hop waits for the Planner (gate, merge, worktree, dispatch); (3) five of 23 execute tasks were fix rounds, two of them design-level; (4) review worktrees had to be pre-created by hand because the MCP server runs old spawn code until restarted. Deliverables: (A) tests split into tests/test_<module>.py with tests/_harness.py holding TMP/REPO/ORCH_ROOT setup and hook(); tests-green discovers all; (B) bus tasks carry depends_on and the daemon (orchestrator/daemon.py) advances tasks: when a task is done and its worktree gate is green it creates the review task (complexity ≥4), spawns it, and on approve merges into goal/<parent> and dispatches queued tasks whose depends_on are all merged; request_changes or failure stops and notifies; (C) spec review: for execute tasks with complexity ≥5, a sonnet reviewer reads the spec before execution and posts approve|request_changes with concrete design risks; the Planner or daemon holds dispatch until approve. Complexity 7 (daemon touches dispatch, merge, spawn). Scouts first; disjoint scopes so C tasks themselves run in parallel.
acceptance: tests/test_orchestrator.py replaced by per-module files sharing tests/_harness.py; full suite green via tests-green.sh and via uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests
bus tasks accept depends_on; daemon tick advances done tasks through gate, review, merge and dispatches dependents; a failing gate or request_changes halts with a notification
spec-review role exists with a prompt template and a test; execute tasks with complexity >=5 are held until the spec review approves
goal branch merged tasks all green; PR goal/<id> -> main opened; decisions.md entry with rollback
